description: Tried the letter shorter than you wanted

participation.context: Said the short version and stopped.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You tried the nights, the laugh, and the brook out loud, and you cut each one down before you wrote. You kept nine pounds as a difference and left the total and the house unsaid.

title: Tried the letter shorter, out loud

description: Set a clean sheet for the letter to Anne

participation.context: Wrote the sheet, set the pen down, and got up without it.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You wrote the letter from the open date through the three children, read it back, and left it flat with no wafer. You gave nine pounds as a difference. You did not open the coffer, and you did not name a carrier.

title: Wrote Anne's letter on the sheet

participation.context: Wrote the letter at the table and did not give it to a carrier.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Not in the house. The sheet is for her, and it waits.
participation.name: Anne Shakespeare

participation.context: Named, and asked for the two faults in the book.
participation.name: Susanna Shakespeare

participation.context: Named, and the tune left unnamed.
participation.name: Judith Shakespeare

participation.context: Named. The ball is for the yard. No sword was asked for at court.

story.body: You answered the brook, stated the difference in the coffer, and refused a house price. You wrote one paragraph to each child and none to your parents. You did not send the sheet.

title: Wrote Anne's letter at the desk

story.body: You did not fold the sheet and you did not open the box beside it.

title: Set the letter flat on the desk

description: Left your father and mother out of the letter

participation.context: Said it and did not pick the pen up.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You refused a paragraph for your father and your mother. The letter stayed as you had signed it. You did not name a carrier, and you did not ask a house price of the empty room.

title: Named the three children in the letter

description: Found the letter open on the board

participation.context: Set the fold down and left the sheet.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You came in, set the pages down, and found Anne's letter where the morning had left it. You did not seal it, and you did not open the coffer.

title: Found the letter still flat on the board

description: Said the letter was open on the board

story.body: You did not seal the sheet and you did not open the box. You had nothing more to say.

title: Ended the night with the letter on the board
